tools.name: ellibo_list_places
tools.description: List the pickup and return places of the rental business. Use it to find where items are collected or returned. Ellibo API: GET /v1/places.

tools.name: ellibo_list_items
tools.description: List rental items with their prices and how many units the business owns. Use it to check what can be rented. Ellibo API: GET /v1/items.

tools.name: ellibo_get_item
tools.description: Get one rental item with its prices and unit count. Ellibo API: GET /v1/items/{id}.

tools.name: ellibo_list_orders
tools.description: List rental orders (quotes, reserved orders, picked up, returned, late and cancelled) with their lines. Ellibo API: GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: ellibo_get_order
tools.description: Get one rental order with its lines and status. Ellibo API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: ellibo_list_order_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of one rental order. Ellibo API: GET /v1/orders/{id}/invoices.
